info.title: Norevify API
info.description: Vehicle expense tracking API with JWT authentication. All authenticated endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Some endpoints additionally require a verified email (`withVerifiedUser`) or the `pro` plan.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Registration, login, password/email flows, account settings

tags.name: Income
tags.description: Income CRUD and profit summaries (pro plan)

tags.name: Cron
tags.description: Scheduled jobs, authenticated via CRON_SECRET bearer token

cronSecret.description: Static secret from the CRON_SECRET environment variable, not a user JWT.

id.description: Mongo ObjectId of the created user. Null when the email was already registered — the endpoint returns the same generic success shape either way to avoid email enumeration.

targetHourlyRate.description: Target net-per-hour rate used to render the income "does it pay?" verdict. Omit or pass null to clear it.

password.description: Required only for accounts with a password set; not required for Google-only accounts.

odometer.description: Optional. Updates the vehicle's currentKm if higher than its current reading.

vehicleId.description: Optional. Defaults to the user's first/only vehicle, auto-creating one if none exists.

recurringRuleId.description: Present when auto-generated from a recurring rule.

startTime.description: Legacy single-block time; superseded by segments

endTime.description: Legacy single-block time; superseded by segments

segments.description: 1-12 non-overlapping HH:MM blocks; hours is derived, not accepted. Cannot be combined with startTime/endTime

startTime.description: Legacy single-block form; provide together with endTime, and only when segments is absent

hours.description: Only accepted when segments/startTime/endTime are absent

kmDriven.description: Fill-to-fill odometer span used for the fuel cost calculation

costPerKm.description: Fill-to-fill fuel DKK/km; null until 2+ odometer-tagged fill-ups exist

costPerKmSamples.description: Number of fill-ups used in costPerKm (excludes the anchor fill)

months.description: Present only when `breakdown=monthly` was requested and no `month` filter was given. One profit row per calendar month of `period.year`.

category.description: Fuel is not allowed for recurring rules.

created.description: Number of expenses generated from overdue occurrences.

ReminderCreate.description: At least one of dueDate or dueKm is required. intervalMonths requires dueDate; intervalKm requires dueKm.

intervalMonths.description: Auto-creates the next reminder this many months after completion.

intervalKm.description: Auto-creates the next reminder this many km after the completion odometer reading.

ReminderUpdate.description: Cannot be used on a completed reminder. completedAt/completedKm/userId cannot be set directly.

next.description: Auto-created follow-up reminder, present only when the completed reminder had intervalMonths and/or intervalKm.

url.description: Stripe Checkout session URL to redirect the user to.

NotFound.description: Resource not found or not owned by the current user

post.description: Rate limited (5/hour/IP). Duplicate email returns the same generic success shape as a fresh registration (no account created, existing address notified) to avoid email enumeration; duplicate username returns 409.
Rate limited (10/15min/IP). 5 consecutive bad passwords locks the account with exponential backoff; a locked-out login still returns the generic 401 (lock state is never revealed).
Rate limited (3/hour/IP). Always returns the same generic message regardless of whether the email exists.

post.summary: Reset password using a reset token
post.description: Rate limited (5/15min/IP). Token is a short-lived JWT emailed by /forgot-password.

post.summary: Sign in (or register) with a Google ID token
post.description: Rate limited (10/15min/IP). Creates a new account on first sign-in unless invite-gated; links to an existing account matching the verified Google email.

post.summary: Verify an email address using the emailed token

Link a Google account to the current user

post.summary: Generate overdue expense occurrences for the current user's active rules
post.description: Idempotent — safe to call repeatedly, lastGeneratedDate prevents duplicates. Normally invoked automatically; this endpoint lets the client force a catch-up.

get.summary: List reminders
get.description: Returns active (non-done) reminders by default. Use ?status=active|upcoming|dueSoon|overdue|done to filter.

200.description: Array of reminders with computed status

post.description: Requires a verified email. At least one of dueDate or dueKm is required.

Get a reminder by ID

put.description: Cannot edit a completed reminder. Changing dueDate/dueKm resets the internal notification marker so status changes get re-notified.

post.description: If the reminder has intervalMonths and/or intervalKm, auto-creates the next reminder.

200.description: Completion result with optional next reminder

get.description: Requires the pro plan (402 reports_feature_locked otherwise). Returns a file download, not JSON.

400.description: format must be csv or pdf, or invalid period

post.summary: Create a Stripe Checkout session to upgrade to pro

400.description: interval must be monthly or annual

500.description: billing_not_configured — missing Stripe price env var

post.summary: Create a Stripe Billing Portal session
post.description: Requires a verified email and an existing Stripe customer (i.e. having gone through checkout at least once).

400.description: no billing account for this user yet

post.description: Not called by API clients — invoked by Stripe. Verifies the `stripe-signature` header against STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Handles checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.updated/deleted, and invoice.payment_failed. Idempotent per event.id; a plan set manually by an admin (planSource: 'manual') is never overwritten by a webhook event.

get.summary: List all users (admin only)
get.description: Requires the caller's user.role to be 'admin' (checked in the service, not the JWT — a stale token cannot self-grant admin).

403.description: admin_required — caller is not an admin

patch.summary: Manually set a user's plan (admin only)
patch.description: Sets planSource: 'manual', which makes the plan immune to being overwritten by subsequent Stripe webhook events for that user.

400.description: plan must be one of: free, pro

403.description: admin_required — caller is not an admin
